zero_shot.description: Direct instruction with no examples. Fast, but least controlled.
zero_shot.template: Write a {output_type} for {subject}. Keep it {tone} and under {max_words} words.

few_shot.description: Provides 1-2 examples before the task to anchor style and format.

chain_of_thought.description: Asks the model to reason step-by-step before producing the final output.
chain_of_thought.template: Think step-by-step about the key selling points of {subject}, then write a {output_type}. First list 3 bullet points of reasoning, then write the final {output_type}. Keep it {tone} and under {max_words} words.

role_based.description: Assigns a persona/role to the model to shape voice and expertise.
role_based.template: You are an expert copywriter specializing in {tone} marketing content. Write a {output_type} for {subject}, using persuasive but honest language. Keep it under {max_words} words.
